name: Stage Startpos
description: Shows the percent your current stage run has to reach next to the percentage

issues.info: Report bugs on GitHub with the level ID and a screenshot.

enabled.name: Show run target
enabled.description: Add the percent the current stage run has to reach to the percentage, like <cy>44.27%/74.27%</c>. Start positions whose run is already done in the current stage show just the percentage.

decimals.name: Target decimals
decimals.description: Decimal places of the target percent.

slash-gap.name: Space around the slash
slash-gap.description: How far the slash sits from the percentages on each side. <cy>0</c> is no space, <cy>15</c> is a full space.

percent-below.name: Percentage under the bar
percent-below.description: In levels with a stage profile, centre the percentage under the progress bar. Needs the progress bar turned on in the game's options.

markers.name: Run markers on the bar
markers.description: Draw a line on the progress bar where the run starts and another where it has to get to.

reached-green.name: Green at the target
reached-green.description: Turn the percentage green once the run reaches its target, including when <cy>Golden Best</c> is active. The color resets on the next attempt.

chime.name: Chime at the target
chime.description: Play a little chime the moment the run reaches its target.

chime-volume.name: Chime volume
chime-volume.description: On top of the game's own sound effect volume.
